seo.title: Thyroid Disorders: Symptoms, Causes, Treatment | Doctors Hub
seo.description: Learn about Thyroid Disorders — symptoms, causes, risk factors, diagnosis, treatment options, and prevention tips.

overview: Thyroid disorders include hypothyroidism (underactive) and hyperthyroidism (overactive), common in India especially among women. Iodine nutrition and autoimmune thyroiditis (Hashimoto's, Graves') are frequent causes.
symptoms: Hypothyroid: fatigue, weight gain, cold intolerance, constipation
Hyperthyroid: weight loss, palpitations, heat intolerance, tremor
riskFactors: Family history of autoimmune thyroid disease
diagnosis: Free T4 and T3 when indicated
treatment: Antithyroid drugs, radioiodine, or surgery for hyperthyroidism
Regular TSH monitoring for dose adjustment
prevention: Adequate iodine through iodised salt (avoid excess)

faqs.question: What causes Thyroid Disorders?
faqs.answer: Multiple factors including genetics, lifestyle, and environment contribute.

faqs.question: Is Thyroid Disorders curable?
faqs.answer: Many conditions are manageable with proper treatment. Consult your doctor for prognosis.

emergencySigns: High fever with agitation and tachycardia (thyroid storm)
Sudden neck swelling with breathing difficulty
